user.title: LG webOS TV Plus
user.description: Enter the TV's IP address. A fixed address (DHCP reservation) is recommended.

pairing.title: Pair with the TV
pairing.description: Make sure the TV at {host} is on. Press Submit, then accept the request on the TV with the remote within {timeout} seconds.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair again
reauth_confirm.description: The TV no longer accepts Home Assistant's key. Make sure the TV at {host} is on. Press Submit, then accept the request on the TV with the remote within {timeout} seconds.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Is the TV on and is "LG Connect Apps" enabled?
error.error_pairing: Pairing was rejected or not accepted in time.

data_description.macs: Filled in automatically when pairing (wired and Wi-Fi).
data_description.root_agent: Adds memory, CPU and swap sensors, the real picture mode and a Free memory button. Needs SSH root access to the TV.

agent.title: Install the root agent
agent.description:
On the TV at {host}, as root:

1. Copy `tv/agent.sh` from the repository to `{agent_path}` and make it executable (`chmod 755`).
2. Add this line to `/home/root/.ssh/authorized_keys`:

```
{key_line}
```

The key can only run the agent (no shell). Then press Submit to test the connection; the TV's SSH host key is remembered on the first success.

error.agent_auth: The TV refused the key. Is the line in authorized_keys?
error.agent_failed: Could not reach the agent. Is the TV on, SSH enabled and the agent installed?

button.name: Press button
button.description: Sends a remote button press (LEFT, RIGHT, UP, DOWN, ENTER, BACK, HOME, MENU, EXIT, INFO, MUTE, RED, GREEN, YELLOW, BLUE, CHANNELUP, CHANNELDOWN, 0-9, ...).

command.name: Send command
command.description: Sends a raw SSAP request to the TV.

select_sound_output.name: Select sound output
select_sound_output.description: Changes where the TV's sound goes.
